overview.en:
Browse Read AI meetings and retrieve summaries, chapters, action items, key questions, topics, transcripts, metrics, and recordings through Read AI's official hosted MCP server.

Turn accessible meeting or interview material into a concise, source-based brief. Identify the conversation and period, then separate decisions, open questions, and action items.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
读取会议摘要、章节、行动项、关键问题、转录与录制资料。

把有权访问的会议或访谈资料整理成有来源的简报。明确会话与时间段，分别列出决策、待确认问题和行动项。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this meeting or interview and cite the relevant passages.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 总结这次会议或访谈，并引用相关片段。

starterPrompts.en: Extract decisions and action items from these conversation records.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 从这些会话记录中提取决策与行动项。

starterPrompts.en: Compare what was discussed across these sessions and identify unresolved questions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这些场次的讨论内容，找出尚未解决的问题。

descriptions.en: Retrieve and analyze Read AI meeting reports through Read AI's official hosted MCP server. Use for meeting lists, summaries, chapters, action items, key questions, topics, transcripts, metrics, and recording links.
